title: XunZi, an AI biologist, reveals disease-modifying targets
decided_by: rule over the two first-pass reviewers
rationale: All first-pass criteria were positive without unresolved uncertainty.
scope_reviewer_rationale: This is a new named model, XunZi, that integrates biomedical publications, structured biological corpora, and multimodal omics data to generate disease-target hypotheses. The text reasoning module is central and is fused with the biological graph model, so the text-bio bridge is substantive.
architecture_reviewer_rationale: The paper introduces XunZi as a new hybrid AI biologist, not just a wrapper, and explicitly says it can “generate de novo therapeutic target hypotheses.” It is built from a 7.3B Mistral 7B LLM with continual pretraining on 24.4M publications and broad biomedical data.
